The '''Port o' Call Café Theater''' was a theater that was situated near to [[Westport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] poet [[Sheel Mafeen]] performed at the theater, and the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|police]] [[Prefect/Legends|prefect]] [[Pol Haus]] visited the establishment to rendezvous with her.
